findings.title: Commands turn making into coordinated staged work
findings.claim: The focus's repeated speech acts make the ruler's making legible as coordinated staging: material is supplied, the gap is leveled, blowing is ordered, the iron is transformed, and the final casting is requested.
findings.mechanism: The carrier جَعَلَ names a change in an existing object's state, while قَالَ introduces operational directions; their contact with the separate bringing, leveling, blowing, fire-state, and pouring markers converts making from solitary production into public coordination.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the barrier as the product of distributed, sequenced labor.
findings.containment: This adds orchestration to the plainly stated metallurgical commands; it does not replace the material construction or claim that speech alone makes the iron.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus-anchored finding supports the relation; the wider 34:13 connection supplies a concrete directed-labor parallel but with target morphology explicitly unavailable, so the global extension remains qualified.

findings.title: Joining makes resistance into a boundary
findings.claim: The focus presents the barrier's strength as a joined result: dense iron pieces are placed across the interval, leveled between the two faces, heated, and capped with molten copper, so resistance becomes a continuous boundary.
findings.mechanism: زُبَرَ supplies discrete dense masses and حَدِيدِ supplies resistant iron; the between-space and two-face geometry, together with the heat and casting sequence, make their contact a boundary-forming assembly rather than isolated material hardness.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wall's efficacy in the organization and closure of interfaces, not in iron considered alone.
findings.containment: This is a bounded process reading; it does not claim a unique metallurgical method or resolve whether the copper primarily bonds joints, coats a face, or does both.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus-anchored finding supports the material relation; the supplied wider connections corroborate joined structure, useful iron, and regulated passage while explicitly withholding target morphology, so those extensions remain qualified.
